content_zh:
季方晓的动作很快, 几乎没有空档, 大概是预料到赵卓荦不会打在那么致命的地方。而位置又选的好, 所以不容易被看出。
连胜在军队里见过不少这样的人，也见过各式各样的手段，很清楚他们心里想什么。
想赢不是错, 谁都想赢。对于士兵来说，他们的全部意义，就是为了赢, 因为他们没有输的退路。可是, 不服输就不大好了。
不服输的人认识不到自己的短处，而且……很碍眼。
连胜说话的时候, 周围人还在鼓掌。她说的声音也不大, 他们还以为是自己听岔了。季方晓也依旧往外面走。
连胜慢条斯理的挽起袖子, 又说了一次：“我也想玩。季方晓。”
这次指名点姓, 说的很清楚。现场稍稍安静, 剩下的都是些窃窃私语, 众人视线在两人之间徘徊。
赵卓荦停在原地，诧异的看她一眼。付教官原本站在人群的后排，闻言迅速走上前来。
付教官问：“怎么？你们想跟大四指挥系的来积分交换赛？”
“不, 当然是我个人。”连胜朝着季方晓伸出手, “怎么样？”
季方晓转回身说：“我不和女生比。”
连胜直接扭头喊道：“教官，他歧视女生。”
付教官：“……”
旁边人不客气的嘘声，拿她打趣。
“别这样啊小妹妹，别欺负你学长。”
“季方晓已经嘴笨了，你别害他找不到女朋友啊。”
“哟哟哟哟哟！季哥刚好单身哟。”
“诶——？不会吧？小妹妹现在都玩这种套路了？我告诉你季哥喜欢温柔的女生啊！”
“脱单不起，溜了溜了！”
几位教官拍手喝道：“安静安静！”

季方晓笑道：“担不起这么大的帽子。不过你既然邀请我，我总有可以拒绝的权利吧？”
“当然。不过刚刚我应该是第二名，既然我以演习第二名的身份邀请你，你又用什么样的理由来回绝我呢？”连胜说，“我不接受女生这样的理由。难不成你在战场上遇到女兵，也扯面子说不打女生？如果你不会，那就都是借口。”
季方晓微微蹙眉，有点不悦了。
付教官插腰上前，说道：“你是认真的？积分交换赛这种事情，不是开玩笑的。”
连胜：“我当然是认真的。不然就为了露个脸吗？”
季方晓上下打量她一通，实在是入不了眼，觉得这人纯粹是凑热闹：“我下手没有轻重。”
连胜：“我也是。”
坐在旁边的群众放声喊道：“答应她了！不然人还真瞧不起你！”
“打打打！”
连胜勾起嘴角：“嗯？男生？输不输得起？”
季方晓：“好吧。”
“既然你都答应了，那就玩得再大一点。”连胜摊开手说，“一场一分多没意思？我可以把我全部的分都押上来。”
季方晓干脆道：“不行。”
连胜耸肩：“为什么不行？我分还可以的。”
“因为规则不行，每场最高只能押十分。”付教官走出来，皱眉道：“连胜，你别开玩笑了啊。”
这是迫不及待送分呢？啊？她还兴这么霸道总裁的玩法？
连胜有些失望。不过也是，如果分数可以这样转让，哪还需要这么麻烦？
季方晓走回场地正中，绅士问道：“还有什么条件吗？”
连胜：“我先说明一下，不打到人我是不会收手的。不被打倒我也是不会收手的。所以，你不用想着抓空隙，也不要最后用所谓的手下留情来解释结果。既然是比赛，我只接受坦荡的过程，以及绝对的结果。”
付教官干咳一声。

季方晓那是谁？他就算没有进指挥系，那差不多也是单兵系的一把手了。要是真一拳实在的打在连胜身上，这货怕是半条命都得飞了。
这个条件听着有点任性，因为季方晓不可能真的对同学下重手，何况这位同学还是一位“柔弱”的女生，但连胜似乎会。看她那语气还有眼神，可没有半点留情的意思。
季方晓知道自己吃亏，还听出连胜似乎意有所指。神色不变，只是淡淡道：“好。”
“比赛不接受中途叫停。也不接受无伤认输。”连胜朝地上一指，“谁先倒下，谁输。”
季方晓点头。
付教官负手在两人中间转了一圈，五官紧皱，看着二人。最后被旁边的一名教官拉开，批评道：“干嘛呢干嘛呢？不要打击学生的热情啊。”

content_en:
Ji Fangxiao's movements were very fast, with almost no gaps. He probably expected that Zhao Zhuorun would not hit such a fatal place. And the location is well chosen, so it’s not easy to see.
Lian Sheng has seen many such people in the army and various methods, and he knows exactly what they are thinking.
There is nothing wrong with wanting to win, everyone wants to win. For soldiers, their whole purpose is to win, because they have no way out of losing. However, it would be bad if you don't admit defeat.
People who refuse to admit defeat do not realize their own shortcomings, and... they are an eyesore.
When Lian Sheng spoke, the people around him were still applauding. She didn't speak loudly, so they thought they had misheard her. Ji Fangxiao also walked outside as usual.
Lian Sheng rolled up his sleeves slowly and said again: "I want to play too. Ji Fangxiao."
This time I named them and made it very clear. The scene became slightly quiet, the rest were just whispers, and everyone's eyes wandered between the two.
Zhao Zhuorun stopped where he was and looked at her in surprise. Instructor Fu was originally standing in the back row of the crowd, but after hearing this, he quickly stepped forward.
Instructor Fu asked: "What? Do you want to have a points exchange competition with the seniors in the command department?"
"No, of course it's me." Lian Sheng stretched out his hand towards Ji Fangxiao, "How about it?"
Ji Fangxiao turned around and said, "I don't compare with girls."
Lian Sheng turned around and shouted: "Instructor, he discriminates against girls."
Instructor Fu: "..."
The people next to her booed unceremoniously and made fun of her.
"Don't be like this, little sister, don't bully your senior."
"Ji Fangxiao is already stupid. Don't let him find a girlfriend."
"Yo yo yo yo! Brother Ji happens to be single."
"Eh -? No way? Is the little sister playing this trick now? Let me tell you that Brother Ji likes gentle girls!"
"I can't afford to be single, so I slipped away!"
Several instructors clapped their hands and shouted: "Quiet, quiet!"
Ji Fangxiao smiled and said: "I can't afford such a big hat. But since you invite me, I always have the right to refuse, right?"
"Of course. But I was supposed to be the second place just now. Since I invited you as the second place in the exercise, what reasons did you use to reject me?" Lian Sheng said, "I don't accept girls' excuses. Is it possible that when you meet a female soldier on the battlefield, you still say that you won't hit girls? If you don't know how, it's all an excuse."
Ji Fangxiao frowned slightly, a little unhappy.
Instructor Fu stepped forward and said, "Are you serious? Point exchange games are not a joke."
Lian Sheng: "Of course I'm serious. Or is it just to show off?"
Ji Fangxiao looked her up and down, but he really couldn't get enough of her. He felt that this person was just joining in the fun: "My attack is not serious."
Streak: "Me too."
The people sitting nearby shouted loudly: "I promised her! Otherwise, people would really look down on you!"
"Hit, hit, hit!"
Lian Sheng raised the corners of his mouth: "Huh? Boy? Can you afford to lose?"
Ji Fangxiao: "Okay."
"Since you agreed, let's play a little bigger." Lian Sheng spread his hands and said, "Is it boring to have more than one point in a game? I can bet all my points."
Ji Fangxiao simply said: "No."
Lian Sheng shrugged: "Why not? My points are fine."
"Because the rules don't work, you can only bet ten points at most in each game." Instructor Fu came out and frowned: "Winning streak, stop joking."
Is this because I can’t wait to give out points? ah? Does she still want to play like a domineering president?
The winning streak was a bit disappointing. But yes, if points can be transferred like this, why bother?
Ji Fangxiao walked back to the center of the venue and the gentleman asked: "Are there any other conditions?"
Lian Sheng: "Let me explain first, I won't stop until I hit someone. I won't stop until I get knocked down. So, you don't have to think about taking advantage of the opportunity.Don't use so-called mercy to explain the results in the end. Since it is a competition, I only accept the frank process and the absolute result. "
Instructor Fu coughed dryly.
Who is Ji Fangxiao? Even if he didn't enter the command department, he would still be the top leader in the individual soldier department. If he had really punched Lian Sheng, half of his life would have been lost.
This condition sounds a bit arbitrary, because Ji Fangxiao can't really hit his classmate hard, not to mention that this classmate is still a "weak" girl, but it seems that Lian Sheng will. Judging from her tone and eyes, she showed no mercy at all.
Ji Fangxiao knew that he was at a disadvantage, and he also heard that the winning streak seemed to have some meaning. His expression remained unchanged, and he just said calmly: "Okay. "
"The game will not be stopped midway. Nor will he accept defeat without injury. "Lian Sheng pointed to the ground, "Whoever falls first, loses. "
Ji Fangxiao nodded.
Instructor Fu moved his hands behind his back and turned around between the two of them, looking at them with his facial features wrinkled. Finally, he was pulled away by an instructor next to him and criticized: "What are you doing? Don't dampen students' enthusiasm. "
